title: Penalty differences in stroke play and match play
question: What is the usual penalty for breaking a rule in stroke play?

choices.text: You have to return to the tee and replay the shot
You get 2 penalty strokes added to your score
You retake the shot with no penalty

explanation: In stroke play, the general penalty for a rule breach is 2 penalty strokes.

juniorVersion.title: What happens if you break a rule in stroke play?
juniorVersion.question: If you break a rule when playing stroke play, what usually happens?

choices.text: You go back to the start and hit again
You get 2 shots added to your score
You hit your shot again with no penalty

juniorVersion.explanation: In stroke play, if you break a rule, most of the time you must add 2 shots to your score for that hole.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A golf game where you count all your shots for every hole.
Extra shots you must add to your score if you break a rule.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Tell kids that in stroke play, following the rules is important because every shot counts. Breaking rules almost always means extra shots on your score.
likelyMisconceptions: Some kids may think you lose the hole like in match play.
Kids might believe you can just retake the shot with no penalty.
